collection.title: VW Jetta 2005 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Jetta 2005 to 2006 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
